prompt: Our service's cache hit rate dropped from 92% to 40% right after we added the user's locale to the cache key. Traffic and the number of cached items did not change. Why, and what should we do?
expect: Key cardinality multiplied by locales, so the same item is cached once per locale; fix by keeping locale out of the key for locale-independent data or caching per-locale parts separately. Ends with a 'Conclusion:' line.

prompt: Memo: We will move the nightly batch from 01:00 to 03:00 because the backup job now runs until 02:30 and both saturate disk I/O. Reports that depend on the batch will be ready at 05:00 instead of 03:00. The finance team must agree, since their 04:00 reconciliation reads those reports.
expect: 3-6 bullets; flags the conflict that reports at 05:00 miss finance's 04:00 reconciliation.
